summary.headline: Manuscript C 263 Inf.
summary.text: Catalog entry for manuscript C 263 inf. (chartaceous, sixteenth century, 350 folios), listing astrological questions on travelers, signs, prisoners, inquiries, and servitudes, followed by tables and diagrams. The manuscript also preserves Hipparchus on the twelve signs, Paulus Alexandrinus on apotelesmatic science, Leontius the mechanic on the zodiacal circle, and Symeon Seth on the usefulness of the heavenly bodies, with chapters on the heavens and Moon.
